Qin qin le du xi lie

"As the saying goes, 'A child's character at three shows the adult at seven.' A person's character begins to take shape in infancy. If we want to help children develop good habits and character, the period before age six is absolutely critical. This book focuses on the development of children's character and habits across different age stages from 0 to 6 years old. It aligns with children's sensitive developmental periods and transforms the core principles of Montessori education into practical guides—highlighting key developmental milestones and offering simple, hands-on parent-child training games. The book presents a comprehensive, progressive, and highly practical educational plan tailored to each stage. Habits form character, and character shapes destiny. During this crucial 0–6 age window, we can work together to ensure children grow up in a nurturing family environment—where they can discover a whole, healthy sense of self
